subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime `sessions.patch` reject legacy ownerless rows immediately, or must upgrades provide an ownership migration or operator recovery path first?
rationale: Exact owner equality for foreign-owned rows follows the existing isolation contract, but authority over persisted legacy ownerless rows is an intentional security and upgrade-policy choice that code review cannot determine.

options.title: Fail closed with recovery
options.body: Reject ownerless plugin-runtime patches and document an explicit operator or non-plugin recovery path.

options.title: Migrate before enforcement
options.body: Add an ownership migration or repair flow before enabling fail-closed behavior for legacy rows.

recommendation.title: Fail closed with recovery
recommendation.body: Reject ownerless plugin-runtime patches and document an explicit operator or non-plugin recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the recent storage-neutral session accessor and SQLite persistence architecture affected by this decision.
